<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

  <metadata>
    <id>NTG.Adk</id>
    <version>1.8.16</version>
    <authors>NTG</authors>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>

        <dependency id="NTG.Adk.CoreAbstractions" version="1.8.16" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="NTG.Adk.Implementations" version="1.8.16" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="NTG.Adk.Operators" version="1.8.16" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection" version="10.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
